Penguin Solutions Fiscal 2026 Results

Fourth Quarter Financial Highlights

Fiscal Q4 net sales reached about $567 million and operating income reached about $69 million. Net income was about $93 million and diluted EPS was $1.29. The latest quarter ended August 28, 2026. These are company-reported release figures, not a newly filed audited annual statement.

Recent Business Highlights

The company described six new AI infrastructure customers during Q4, including four neoclouds. Lektra selected the AI Factory Platform for distributed micro-data centers. Penguin also described a 36,000-GPU Norway deployment for a neocloud customer. ClusterWareAI gained additional self-managing features.

Fiscal 2026 Highlights

Fiscal-year net sales were $1.731 billion across Advanced Computing, Integrated Memory, and Optimized LED. The company reported operating income of about $166 million for FY2026.
